name: Eau de Attrait
body:
Price 1,600 gp; Aura faint conjuration; CL 4th; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

A blue satin tassel dangles from the bulb of this bulb-shaped perfume bottle of clear glass. The dispenser can hold up to 50 doses of magically enhanced perfume. Any liquid dispensed from this bottle acts as a fine perfume, granting a +4 competence bonus to Charisma-based checks for 24 hours.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 800 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells heroism
